witnesses.strategy: Select the whole-goal LEFT alternative, keeping os_inv sg observed in the antecedent. Unfold abs_deinit_dataqueue; use safeExec of assertS to obtain dataqueue_cleanup_entry for the initial LastSeen set. Crtos_RTrans before observed establishes membership in that observation set. Instantiate entry at observed to get os_inv |-- cleanup_guard, then project both quiescence facts while preserving os_inv by pure extraction/frame. Cancel InsideCritical/private store_dataqueue unchanged. Do not select the pure emp fallback: its generated split drops the os_inv needed by cleanup_entry. Whitelist001 permits this checked observation model, not assuming the resulting facts without this argument.

Invalid-ID and lookup-miss cases have after=observed, so reuse old quiescence. In the hit case after=replace_semaphores(filter-out-address) observed: every surviving semaphore was an old member, pending fields are unchanged, and dataqueue_map is unchanged. Apply old semaphore_delete_quiescent for the second ID to those old members and identical map lookups. This holds even if IDs coincide; removal cannot create waiters/references. No os_inv or freshness assumption is required for this pure monotonicity.

First ID uses saved delete effect in 1/3, middle=observed in 2/4. These two branch choices construct dataqueue_cleanup_effect q observed final exactly, with no additional semaphore existence premise. Use safeExec of assertS followed by os_atomic_cmd, observed membership from RTrans, and high-step/atomic refinement to derive safeExec(LastSeen final,ret tt,X) and GTrans observed final. Reassemble store_dataqueue p (dataqueue_retired q): base=0/slots=nil eliminates buffer, keep front/rear/max_len, blank already retired, and data=-1 or preserved negative according to branch guard. Nonzero/alignment and padding are in the antecedent. Frame InsideCritical sg observed and current os_inv sg final. No resource is inferred merely from the pure effect.

witnesses.name: proof_of_DeInitDataqueue_which_implies_wit_1
witnesses.strategy: Unfold store_dataqueue into nonzero/aligned structure fields, padding and dataqueue_buffer. Choose each existential field value from q. Split on dq_base q=0. Null branch buffer is emp and slots=nil; choose left alternative and cancel all fields/padding. Nonnull branch has positive max_len and complete store_array dataqueue_slot; prove its conversion into CharArray.undef_full base (max_len*8) by induction on slots/array representation. For None slots forget no values; for Some slots forget data/length values using typed-store-to-undef facts. Authorized dataqueue_layout_abi converts offsets and 8-byte strides; concatenate each slot two four-byte blocks, retaining the structure/padding frame. Array length originates in store_array and scalar range in field stores, not a new assumption. dataqueue_buffer_free_obligation is only a Prop and must not be used as a theorem.
